concept.title: Autofill Best Practices
concept.shortdesc: A list of ways to mitigate the risks of using autofill.

p.ul: Require manual confirmation before filling forms
Regularly review and delete old autofill entries
Avoid autofill entirely on unfamiliar websites
Enable multi‑factor authentication on all key accounts
Enable built‑in phishing and site warnings
Use a dedicated password manager instead of browser password autofill
